text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(The more I think about it, the more I<n>realize I don't
know that much about<n>Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I didn't think you'd go straight home<n>after that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: No way. You're not one to give up<n>easily.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: No way. You're not one to give up<n>easily.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... what's your dream?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy... what's your dream?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's kind enough to find out all<n>about me... and
tries to know even<n>more... But I... I only know about
myself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
How could a person like me share the<n>name of a
hero?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What am I doing? If I have time<n>to think about
this, I should be doing<n>something productive!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Right, I want to know more about<n>Trainer. It's no
use just imagining<n>everything. I need to learn about
the<n>real Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(But how? It's not like I can go right<n>up and say,
"Tell me about yourself"...<n>That's too
embarrassing.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hyagh! Oh, um, uh, Trainer! H-hello.<n>Um... What are
the chances? Are you<n>on a walk?
choice_data_list: Just thought I'd go do some shopping.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Ah! This is it! I think now might be<n>the perfect
chance to learn more<n>about Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Um, me too! So, uh... if it's okay...<n>could we...
Would you mind... if we go<n>together?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I really love this bookstore. It's so<n>large! They carry
lots of new titles<n>and always have a plethora of
things<n>on hand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, where's Trainer? Oh no, I was<n>too distracted
by the books...

text_block_list.name: Stranger
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really didn't know what to do.<n>Thank you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Stranger
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so just to make sure, right up<n>that escalator
over there...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Was that person asking for<n>directions? To find a
store maybe?<n>And Trainer was kind enough to stop
and help...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, it must be! That man looks so<n>relieved now. I
can relate—Trainer is<n>so easy to approach for help!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Always so kind and considerate...<n>Hehehe. Trainer
really is just how<n>I've been imagining.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry about before. We got<n>separated when I
saw the bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're quite the heavy reader<n>yourself, aren't
you? I know you<n>keep those hefty texts on your
desk.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's like I always thought. You're a<n>diligent studier
who works very hard.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try to recall what's on my desk in<n>the office. I do
have some volumes<n>that I put covers on...
choice_data_list: Ohh, the manga I borrowed from another trainer!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Manga? They're not training<n>textbooks?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...O-oh, that's interesting! I happen to<n>read manga
as well. You'll have to<n>tell me what kind of story it
is<n>sometime!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... Ah, that's right. I noticed a man<n>was talking to
you earlier.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Was he asking how to get to a store?<n>You're so
kind to put all that effort<n>into helping like that.
choice_data_list: Oh, you mean that gym recruiter?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh, a gym recruiter, you say?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
He was telling me how plenty of<n>people listen to his
pitch, but no one<n>ever agrees to take a tour. He was
pretty bummed.
choice_data_list: He said I could get a free trial workout.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh... wow! That's nice. Exercise is<n>quite
invigorating, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Now I've gone and done it! I made<n>all those
assumptions before asking...<n>How rude of me.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(However, it's true that Trainer is<n>always
hardworking and kind.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Still...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry about all that. I was<n>assuming too much.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Assuming? I guess she's talking<n>about how she
thought I had<n>textbooks and was giving directions.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But that's nothing to apologize for.<n>She made those
assumptions<n>because she sees me as<n>hardworking
and kind...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I'll try my best to be that kind of person.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy seems a little down, but it's<n>probably
nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If that's the type of trainer she<n>envisions, then
that's the ideal I'll<n>strive to be.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And someday, when I truly achieve<n>that...
choice_data_list: I'd be really happy to make you proud.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (What a thoughtful thing to say...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Trainer really is kind... Although...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I may have gone too far... I hope I<n>didn't force my
ideal image on<n>Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I appreciate those words. Making the<n>effort to live
up to someone's<n>expectations takes such...
warmth.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(But... the last thing I'd want is to<n>push Trainer into
a corner for my own<n>selfish ideals.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Under the rays of the setting sun, I<n>make a silent
vow to myself. I want to<n>work hard to get closer to
the ideal<n>that a hero would want.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Beside me, Zenno Rob Roy casts her<n>eyes down to
the sunset-tinted road.<n>She also seems troubled by
some<n>complicated thoughts.
